exam: 2024年6月 第2套 · 仔细阅读 P2
title: Today, most scientific research is funded by government gran…

sents.en: Today, most scientific research is funded by government grants, companies doing research and development and non-profit foundations.
sents.cn: 如今，多数科学研究由政府拨款、从事研发的企业以及非营利基金会资助。

sents.en: As a society, we reap the rewards from this science but we also help pay for it.
sents.cn: 作为社会的一员，我们既从科学中获益，也为此买单。

sents.en: You indirectly support science through taxes you pay, products and services you purchase, and donations you make.
sents.cn: 你通过所纳税款、所购买的产品与服务，以及所捐出的善款，间接支持着科学。

sents.en: Funding for science has changed with the times.
sents.cn: 科学的资助方式随时代而变。

sents.en: Historically, science has been largely supported through private patronage (资助), church sponsorship or simply paying for the research yourself.
sents.cn: 历史上，科学主要依靠私人赞助、教会资助，或干脆由研究者自掏腰包。

sents.en: Today, researchers are likely to be funded by a mix of grants from various government agencies, institutions, and foundations.
sents.cn: 如今，研究者往往由各类政府机构、院校和基金会的拨款混合资助。

sents.en: Other research is funded by private companies.
sents.cn: 另一些研究由私营企业资助。

sents.en: Such corporate sponsorship is widespread in some fields. Almost 75% of U.S. clinical trials in medicine are paid for by private companies.
sents.cn: 这种企业赞助在某些领域十分普遍——美国近75%的医学临床试验由私人公司出资。

sents.en: And, of course, some researchers today still fund small-scale studies out of their own pockets.
sents.cn: 当然，如今仍有一些研究者自掏腰包开展小规模研究。

sents.en: Most of us can't afford to do nuclear research as a private hobby, but bird watchers, rock collectors, and others can do real research on a limited budget.
sents.cn: 我们多数人负担不起把核研究当私人爱好，但观鸟者、岩石收藏者等人，却能在有限预算下做真正的科研。

sents.en: In a perfect world, money wouldn't matter · all scientific studies would be completely objective.
sents.cn: 在理想世界里，金钱无关紧要——所有科学研究都会完全客观。

sents.en: But in the real world, funding may introduce biases.
sents.cn: 但在现实中，资助可能带来偏见。

sents.en: Drug research sponsored by the pharmaceutical (制药的) industry is more likely to end up favoring the drug under consideration than studies sponsored by government grants or charitable organizations.
sents.cn: 相比由政府拨款或慈善组织资助的研究，制药行业资助的药物研究更可能偏向所考察的药物。

sents.en: Similarly, nutrition research sponsored by the food industry is more likely to end up favoring the food under consideration than independently funded research.
sents.cn: 同样，相比独立资助的研究，食品行业资助的营养研究更可能偏向所考察的食品。

sents.en: So what should we make of all this?
sents.cn: 那么我们该如何看待这一切？

sents.en: Should we ignore any research funded by companies or special interest groups?
sents.cn: 我们是否该无视企业或特殊利益集团资助的研究？

sents.en: Certainly not.
sents.cn: 当然不该。

sents.en: These groups provide invaluable funding for scientific research.
sents.cn: 这些群体为科学研究提供了宝贵的资金。

sents.en: Furthermore, science has many safeguards in place to catch instances of bias that affect research outcomes.
sents.cn: 此外，科学设有诸多防范机制，以捕捉影响研究结果的偏见。

sents.en: Ultimately, misleading results will be corrected as science proceeds, however, this process takes time.
sents.cn: 归根结底，随着科学推进，误导性结果终将得到纠正，只是这个过程需要时间。

sents.en: Meanwhile, it pays to examine studies funded by industry or special interest groups with extra care.
sents.cn: 与此同时，对由企业或特殊利益集团资助的研究多留个心眼是值得的。

sents.en: Are the results consistent with other independently funded studies?
sents.cn: 其结果是否与其他独立资助的研究一致？

sents.en: What do other scientists have to say about this research?
sents.cn: 其他科学家对此有何看法？

sents.en: A little examination can go a long way towards identifying bias associated with the funding source.
sents.cn: 稍加审视，就能在识别与资金来源相关的偏见上大有助益。
